description: This file implements a Python class `JiraService` that serves as a wrapper to interact with Jira via an MCP client process. It provides methods to create issues, transition issues, and add comments to Jira issues, by executing external commands with JSON payloads. The file includes configuration management, logging, subprocess handling, and utility functions for status mapping.

classes.name: JiraService
classes.description: A service class that communicates with Jira via an MCP client process using system calls, providing methods for issue creation, status transition, and comments.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the JiraService instance, fetching configuration.

methods.name: bool _is_enabled(self)
methods.description: Checks if Jira integration is enabled based on the configuration.

methods.name: Optional[dict[str,Any]] _run_tool(self, tool_name: str, args: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Executes a specified MCP client tool with given arguments, handling JSON payloads and output.

methods.name: Optional[str] create_issue(self, *, project_key: str, summary: str, description: str, issue_type: str = "Task")
methods.description: Creates a Jira issue with provided details, returning the issue key if successful.

methods.name: bool transition_issue(self, *, issue_key: str, status_name: str)
methods.description: Transitions a Jira issue to a new status, returning success as boolean.

methods.name: bool add_comment(self, *, issue_key: str, comment: str)
methods.description: Adds a comment to a Jira issue, returning success as boolean.
